headline: Samsung Integrates Processing Units Directly into DRAM Banks
lede: By embedding compute-capable logic into standard memory banks, Samsung aims to bypass the traditional data-movement bottleneck. This novel PIM architecture shifts the burden of multiply-accumulate operations closer to the data itself, though current software limitations remain a hurdle.

headline: Poland Keeps the Last Steam Passenger Service Running
lede: The Wolsztyn roundhouse preserves a vanishing era of transport by maintaining active, standard-gauge steam passenger routes. This unique operational museum proves that 20th-century engineering can still serve modern transit needs.

headline: Why GUIs Should Prioritize Keyboard Navigation
lede: The artificial divide between graphical interfaces and command-line tools often ignores the essential needs of power users and those with accessibility requirements. True interface mastery demands that the keyboard remains a primary, not secondary, mode of navigation.
pullquote: A graphical interface without keyboard support is a broken design for any user.

headline: Fixing a Memory Alias Bug in Go for 32-Bit Systems
lede: A long-standing flaw in the Go runtime caused intermittent crashes by misidentifying file descriptors on 32-bit ARM and i386 architectures. This fix highlights the vulnerability of legacy platforms to architectural assumptions hidden within modern toolchains.

headline: Booting Virtualized iPhone Instances on Apple Silicon
lede: New open-source tools allow developers to harness Apple's native virtualization stack for automated iOS testing. By bypassing hardware limitations, this approach enables a more programmatic and scalable method for researching mobile environments.

headline: TurboKV Offers High-Performance Asynchronous Storage for Rust
lede: TurboKV optimizes embedded key-value operations through asynchronous background compaction and configurable durability. It provides developers granular control over I/O behavior, ensuring performance remains tunable across varied workloads.

headline: Htmx 4.0 Migrates to Modern Fetch API
lede: The latest release of htmx shifts its architectural foundation to the fetch API while introducing refined event management and scripting capabilities. This transition maintains the library's focus on lightweight, server-driven interactivity for modern web applications.

headline: U.S. Sanctions Target Italian Privacy Collective
lede: The designation of Autistici/Inventati as a target for U.S. sanctions marks a concerning shift in the extraterritorial reach of state intervention. This action against a small, volunteer-run infrastructure provider raises alarms about the future of independent digital self-defense.

headline: Lemmalog Combines Datalog Logic with LLM Reasoning
lede: To mitigate hallucination in agentic workflows, Lemmalog treats vulnerability research as a formal program analysis problem. By enforcing a structured state manager alongside fuzzy LLM reasoning, it ensures every conclusion remains grounded in verifiable facts.

headline: StemDeck Enables Local AI Stem Separation
lede: Users can now extract audio stems from tracks entirely offline using this open-source tool built on Meta's Demucs model. By removing the need for cloud subscriptions, it provides a high-quality, privacy-first alternative for musicians and hobbyists.
